viewport.label: phone-half
viewport.hint: roughly HALF of a phone screen (very little vertical room)

summary: The layout mostly fits the viewport, but there are clear RTL text alignment and bidirectional formatting artifacts in the input and list components.

issues.title: RTL placeholder punctuation artifact
issues.description: Placeholder text renders with a misplaced leading dot due to unresolved bidirectional directionality in RTL mode.
issues.evidence: Input field shows '.Search commands and events' with the dot positioned on the left.
issues.suggestion: Set base text direction to RTL and isolate neutral punctuation characters.

issues.title: Inconsistent action item mirroring
issues.description: Command items show disjointed spacing with left-pinned shortcut badges and right-pinned text and icons.
issues.evidence: Rows show shortcut badges pinned to the left edge while titles and icons cluster at the right edge.
issues.suggestion: Align shortcut keys to the far end according to standard RTL mirroring conventions.
